subject: design/merge-lane-v1
statement: The lane is **repo-native and deterministic**: one hermetic classifier verb — the single lane predicate — computes `(diff, policy, check states) → one typed lane verdict`, fail-closed; a thin platform-workflow adapter invokes it per proposal event, records the verdict, and — in enforce mode only, with the operator's activation acts present — submits the approval and the merge **as the dedicated machine identity, bound to the exact evaluated head revision**, with the credential held in the executing medium's secret store, never reachable from any drive session. The risk policy is **one dedicated, versioned, closed-schema file at the repo's config surface**, changed only with the operator's recorded ratification (the existing gate-policy trailer mechanism, widened to it); the kill switch is one field in it. Shadow mode is the same classifier with the acting layer disabled: verdicts recorded, nothing performed. Everything the lane runs and reads — the classifier, the workflow logic, the review-verdict check arm it trusts, the policy — is taken from the trusted mainline context, never from the proposal under evaluation, and the lane's own code and build inputs are floor-gated so no code class can ratify them into AUTO (DINV-9, DINV-6). (design-brainstorm:argus-unattended-drive-tech-design#D-2, #D-3)
